title: 第一卷 第11章 一打四优势在我第一卷 第12章 姓吴的还我小师妹命来
content_zh:
坏了！
那吴家子弟心中一凛，顾不得痛骂吴飞，双臂一错，横在了身前！
他觉得。
以他锻体中期的修为，硬接这一拳应该还是不难的。
“咔嚓——！”
拳臂瞬间相交，一道清晰的骨裂声也随之响起！
怎么可能！
剧痛传来，那吴家子弟瞳孔骤然一缩，猛地看向顾尘！
我没接住？
是我草率了？
还是他太强了？
念头转过中，他却没看到顾尘的脸，只看到了另外一只拳头！
“砰——！”
“砰——！”
“……”
顾尘的拳势好似溪流，一如先前，一旦将对手卷了进去，便绵绵不绝，近乎永不停歇！
拳头不断落下，比先前重了太多，速度也快了太多。
纵然依旧是溪流。
可流速却比先前湍急了太多太多！
不过两个呼吸！顾尘已是挥出了十余拳，待最后一拳落下，正中那人心口！

砰的一声！
身体倒飞而出，那人飞出数丈，落在地上一动不动了！
这一幕！
彻底看傻了其余四人！
“我赶时间！”
“你们一起上！”
十余拳便打死一人，顾尘拳势并未停下，直接将四人一起卷了进去！
“砰砰砰——！”
拳风席卷！
越发凌厉！
经脉内灵力流动速度亦是越发湍急，越发迅捷，也让他的拳势变得越发难以抵挡！
明明一打四！
优势却在他！
而且是压倒性的优势！
拳风呼啸而过，带起的狂风卷起枯叶，竟随着他的拳势不停变换形状，直至最后，化作了一条枯叶溪流，冲霄之上！
至此！
灵溪拳势初成，也彻底把四人卷得踉跄后退，再没了丝毫反抗之力！
“砰砰砰砰——！”
又是数个呼吸之后！
content_en:
broken!
The disciple of the Wu family felt a chill in his heart. He didn't care to scold Wu Fei and crossed his arms in front of him!
he felt.
With his cultivation in the middle stage of physical training, it shouldn't be difficult to receive this punch forcefully.
"Crack——!"
The fists and arms met instantly, and a clear sound of bone cracking was heard!
How is that possible!
Severe pain came, and the Wu family disciple's pupils suddenly shrank and he looked at Gu Chen suddenly!
Didn't I catch it?
Am I being hasty?
Or is he too strong?
As his thoughts turned around, he didn't see Gu Chen's face, only the other fist!
"Bang——!"
"Bang——!"
"..."
Gu Chen's punches were like a stream. Just like before, once he drew his opponent in, it would flow continuously, almost never ending!
The fist kept falling, much heavier than before, and much faster.
Even though it is still a stream.
But the flow rate is much faster than before!
Just two breaths! Gu Chen had already thrown more than ten punches, and when the last punch fell, it hit the man's heart!
Bang!
The body flew out upside down, and the man flew several feet away and landed on the ground motionless!
This scene!
The other four were completely dumbfounded!
"I'm in a hurry!"
"You guys come together!"
One person was killed in more than ten punches. Gu Chen's punches did not stop and he directly involved the four of them!
“Bang bang bang—!”
The boxing wind swept across!
More and more fierce!
The flow of spiritual power in the meridians became more and more rapid, making his punches more and more difficult to resist!
It's obviously one against four!
The advantage is his!
And it’s an overwhelming advantage!
The wind of the fist roared past, and the strong wind brought up the dead leaves, which kept changing shape with his fists, until finally, it turned into a stream of dead leaves, soaring into the sky!
That’s it!
Lingxi's fist was just beginning to take shape, and it completely rolled the four of them back, leaving them without the slightest strength to resist!
“Bang bang bang bang—!”
After a few more breaths!
